memory_candidates.content: For a specs-only, markdown-only implement phase (report/summary file_scope, no code) whose final phase declares Verification Tier: full under a multi-task batch's Batch Gate Deferral directive: neither narrowing invocation (run-all.sh --only SUITE, verify-deploy.sh --only-gate N) maps to specs/**.md content, since every verify-deploy.sh gate targets .claude/** deploy-tree-vs-source-store sync or shell test suites. This is the dispatch's own documented UNMAPPABLE CRITERION case -- discharge it by running the phase's own named checks directly (validate-artifact.sh on each artifact, a git status --short scoped review for out-of-scope paths) and recording that the full verify-deploy.sh battery is deferred to the batch-level stage, rather than treating the full tier as unsatisfiable or independently running an irrelevant gate subset.
